about: Taqueria Los Chavos is a taco truck at 1800 Harvey Mitchell Pkwy S in College Station.
Reviewers praise the birria torta, quesabirria, gorditas, breakfast tacos and green salsa, and note everything is made on the spot.
Customers have given it 4.7 stars across 129 Google reviews.
